prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, grab it and do task. If not visible, approach else move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectPropertiesAndDoTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectPropertiesAndDoTask
	END
